meta_description: Wharfedale Garden Care in Leeds offers professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and seasonal care. Reliable local gardeners serving Yeadon and surrounding areas.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to seasonal maintenance, Wharfedale Garden Care transforms Leeds gardens into spaces you'll love spending time in.
services_heading: Complete Garden Maintenance Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: Whether you need weekly upkeep, seasonal deep cleans, or full landscaping overhauls, we handle every aspect of garden care.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly cutting, edging, and weeding keeps your borders tidy and your lawn pristine. We tailor visits to your garden's needs and your schedule.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Trimming
services.desc: Professional pruning and shaping of hedges, shrubs, and topiary. We remove overgrown growth safely and keep plants healthy for years to come.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidying
services.desc: Overgrown borders, fallen leaves, and tangled growth cleared quickly. We haul away all waste responsibly, leaving your garden ready for replanting.

services.title: Seasonal Deep Cleans
services.desc: Spring refresh or autumn clear-up — we tackle leaf removal, winter prep, and beds readied for new planting. Your garden ready for the season ahead.

services.title: Lawn Care & Feeding
services.desc: Expert lawn treatment, scarifying, and feeding to thicken grass and eliminate moss. A healthier lawn that handles Leeds weather beautifully.

services.title: Garden Design Consultations
services.desc: Not sure what to plant or how to use your space? We advise on layouts, plant choices, and improvements tailored to your budget and style.

about_pullquote: I started Wharfedale because too many gardens were left neglected. We change that.
about_para_1: Wharfedale Garden Care has been caring for Leeds and Yeadon gardens for over 15 years. We started as a one-man operation and have grown into a trusted local team, maintaining over 500 gardens across the area. Our roots run deep in the community, and we take pride in knowing our customers by name.
about_para_2: We're not here to rush in, mow the lawn, and leave. We listen to what you want your garden to become and work season after season to get it there. Customers return to us because we're reliable, reasonably priced, and we genuinely care about the quality of the work we do.
reviews_heading: What Yeadon & Leeds Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant service. My back garden was a complete mess, totally overgrown. These lads cleared it all, tidied the borders, and now it looks amazing. Been using them every two weeks since and can't fault them. Fair prices too.
reviews.author: Mike T.

reviews.text: Had Wharfedale in to do some serious pruning on the hedges and tidy up the borders for spring. Really know what they're doing, very professional. My garden looks half the size but in a good way! Will have them back.
reviews.author: Sarah L.

reviews.text: Called them in a panic because my garden was embarrassing for a summer party. They cleared everything, cut the lawn, even gave us some ideas for planting. Job done in two days. Proper local lads, no nonsense, great value.
reviews.author: James P.
